text: Hi, not sure if this is a silly thing to message about, I'm his stepdad and still learning what's normal for him. He's 11, temp is 38.7. He's been complaining his ear hurts most of the evening and keeps pulling at it, so I thought ear infection maybe. But when I helped him change his top I noticed some little dark reddish purple dots on his chest and a couple on his arm. I remembered the glass thing so I pressed a glass on them and they didn't fade, I could still see them clearly through it. I tried it twice in case I was doing it wrong. His mum's on a night shift and I don't want to worry her over nothing, but I also don't want to ignore something I shouldn't. Could you tell me what to do
